name: Saptarishi Agro Industries Ltd
about: Saptarishi Agro Industries Ltd engages in trading of mushrooms and other allied agricultural products in India. It is involved in manufacture and trade in of frozen French fries and vegetables; and land development and sale of residential plots. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Chennai, India. Saptarishi Agro Industries Ltd is a subsidiary of Calibre Rehabs Private Limited.
